name: IC 779 (Hubble)
blurb: IC 779, a lenticular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc7369-hubble
story: IC 779 is a lenticular galaxy with a star-like nucleus at its heart, suspected to belong to the Coma I group. Hubble came here to gauge its distance from its individual stars.

claims.text: IC 779 is the same galaxy as UGC 7369
IC 779 is a lenticular galaxy with a semi-stellar (star-like) nucleus
It is suspected to be a member of the Coma I group
It was imaged with Hubble ACS (program 9771) to measure distances from stars at the tip of the red giant branch
